title: Transcription Factors: A Promising Third-Generation Core Sensing Element for Developing Low-Cost, On-Site Rapid Detection Technologies for Food Contaminants.
authors: Mao, Wenhui; Hu, Liangshu; He, Miao; Zhang, Jingfang; Xia, Shiqi; Guo, Mingzhang; Liu, Huilin; Yang, Huijuan; Luo, Yunbo
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦转录因子作为生物传感识别元件用于食品污染物检测，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点优化和AI辅助分析，但核心是传感器应用而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法深度有限。
abstract: Biosensors couple biological recognition elements with signal transducers to provide rapid, low-cost alternatives to conventional food analysis. Beyond antibodies and aptamers, transcription factors (TFs) are emerging as highly sensitive recognition modules because they deliver intrinsic transcriptional signal amplification. TF-based sensors are effective for food-relevant small molecules and heavy metal ions that are often difficult to detect with antibodies, and they can be produced inexpensively in microbial systems. Enabled by synthetic biology, these platforms are advancing toward practical use in food safety monitoring. This review summarizes TF architecture, discovery, and engineering; introduces a proximal mutagenesis strategy; and outlines a coordinated approach to optimize TFs and their cognate DNA-binding sites. The review further integrates TF engineering with artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted analysis to identify and characterize performance-defining functional sites and to highlight remaining challenges and opportunities for food safety diagnostics.
abstract_zh: 生物传感器将生物识别元件与信号转导器相结合，为传统食品分析提供快速、低成本的替代方案。除抗体和适配体之外，转录因子（TFs）正作为高灵敏度识别模块崭露头角，因为它们能提供内在的转录信号放大效应。基于转录因子的传感器对食品相关小分子和重金属离子有效，这些物质通常难以用抗体检测，且可在微生物系统中以低成本生产。在合成生物学的推动下，这些平台正朝着食品安全监测的实际应用迈进。本综述总结了转录因子的结构、发现和工程改造；介绍了一种邻近诱变策略；并概述了优化转录因子及其同源DNA结合位点的协调方法。综述进一步将转录因子工程与人工智能（AI）辅助分析相结合，以识别和表征决定性能的功能位点，并强调食品安全诊断中尚存的挑战与机遇。
